text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I am attending the "Yaeno Muteki Brigade" fan meetup
that Yaeno Muteki invited me to previously.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you very much
for organizing such a wonderful event for my sake today.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To express my daily gratitude to you all,
there is something I wish to perform. Over here—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
What I am about to show you
is the Kongo Yaegaki Style's "Rite of the Eight Desolations."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It is an ascetic discipline where one performs every single kata
of the Kongo Yaegaki Style, followed immediately by continuous sparring matches against the dojo's students.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
In our school, this is a realm undertaken only by assistant instructors.
It is said to be one of the most grueling trials.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...This is an uncharted challenge for me as well.
I would be honored if you all would serve
as witnesses to my undertaking.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki's focused expression and the solemn atmosphere
of the dojo naturally caused the fans' expressions
to turn serious as well—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Now then, begin!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Fu! ...Haaah!
...Sei! ...Yaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Throughout the dojo, the sharp sounds of Yaeno Muteki's
fists and kicks cleaving through the air echoed endlessly—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Kata trial, halt! We now transition to the sparring trial.
First opponent, step forward! ...Begin!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Kuh... haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Only one opponent remained in the sparring trial.
However, clear fatigue showed on Yaeno Muteki's face.
...And right at that moment—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: *(Slip! Thud!)*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Slipping in her sweat, she tumbled to the ground.
Her ragged breathing echoed throughout the venue.
I rushed forward in a panic, but—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Please wait!
...Look closely at Yaeno-san's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (...My body... is so heavy... It hurts. My arms and legs feel as if weights are wrapped around them... and yet—)

text_block_list.name: Dojo Student B
text_block_list.text:
Me too! Smashing through any wall with raw fighting spirit!
I've always respected that attitude of yours!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (No matter what wall stands before me, no matter how fierce the bout... I will face it... Nay, I shall shatter it to pieces...!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That is... my—...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: One more bout... Come at meeeeee!!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
That is enough! Yaeno Muteki.
With this, the "Eight Directions Ascetic Rite" is concluded, and you are certified to have fully completed it...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Haah... haah... haah... haah...
...Everyone.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I shall keep the fire in my soul blazing...
and keep challenging myself with boiling fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That is what I can show you all.
That is precisely what I desire you to witness. Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Please keep watching my back from here on as well.
...Osu!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Yaeno-san will always rise again. She will see it through.
Because... that is who Yaeno Muteki is...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Those eyes, that burning spirit...
They make our hearts blaze and tremble with excitement!

text_block_list.name: Dojo Student A
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno-san, I've decided!
I'm joining the Yaeno Muteki Fan Club too!!

text_block_list.name: Dojo Students
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, no fair...! I want to join too!
—Actually, I've wanted to join for ages...!
—Please let me join as well!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki blazes with spirit, confronting any barrier.
Her fans revere and watch over her.
The passionate bond between them looks set to grow even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki Fan Club Leader
text_block_list.text:
We truly witnessed something spectacular today.
How can we ever thank you...?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan A
text_block_list.text: We'd love to host an appreciation party and a victory celebration next time...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: When that time comes, I shall undertake brand new ascetic trials to answer everyone's feelings!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki blazes with spirit, confronting any barrier.
Her fans revere and watch over her.
Their dazzling bond left a deep impression.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki Fan Club Leader
text_block_list.text:
...Yaeno-san. Thank you for your hard work!
We, the Yaeno Muteki Fan Club, will continue cheering you on forever.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki Fan Club
text_block_list.text: Osu!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki blazes with spirit, confronting any barrier.
Her fans revere and watch over her.
I was completely overwhelmed by their intense bond.
